title: Saskatoon Berry Gratin
description: A Japanese-inspired dessert featuring sweet saskatoon berries topped with a crispy gratin crust.
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together saskatoon berries, sugar, cinnamon, and nutmeg.
Transfer the berry mixture to a 6-inch baking dish.
Top with jammy berries and ukrainian cheese.
In a small bowl, mix together grated gratin and a pinch of salt.
Sprinkle the gratin mixture evenly over the top of the berry mixture.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the gratin is golden brown and the berries are bubbly.
Serve warm, topped with additional jammy berries if desired.
